comments.comment: [GOV-01] Interactive action code 8 is structure demolition; message 6022 and its command execution remove the target structure and return stored quantities to the owning city.
[GOV-01] Interactive action code 9 is unit deployment; its state machine creates the shared unit-deployment command documented by RE-SAN9PK-0076/0078.
[GOV-01] Interactive action code 10 is construction; its state machine creates the shared construction-unit command documented by RE-SAN9PK-0084/0086.
[GOV-01] Interactive action code 11 is troop transport; interactive and automatic producers share the type-11 transport command.
[GOV-01] Interactive action code 12 manages corps organization, dissolution and modification; message 5904 and the shared command side effects establish the mapping.
[GOV-01] Corps command execution: mode 0 creates and appends a corps, mode 1 changes leader/territory/assets and balances funds/food, other modes remove and finalize the selected corps.
[GOV-01] Interactive action code 14 assigns peerage; execution changes each selected officer's title and adjusts loyalty from the title-value difference.
[GOV-01] Interactive action code 17 confiscates an item; execution transfers the item away from its holder and applies the command's loyalty penalty.
[GOV-01] This deleting destructor belongs to the patrol action vtable immediately following the code-12 task vtable; it is not a code-12 slot.

semantic_corrections.correction: command type 14 assigns person shak office ranks; peerage_assignment names were replaced by office_assignment names; root-force kans peerage remains event-driven
